text:
You don't need
more event options.

You have Meetup.
You have Eventbrite.
You have 12 open tabs.

And you're still home
on Friday night.

Because discovery
was never the problem.

sub:
Pick one thing. Go. Talk to one person.
Follow up. *Repeat*.

text:
Run the loop weekly
and a social life compounds.
sub: Browse events nightly and nothing does.
